jobs.description:
**Role and impact

**How do you help a new catalyst product move from development towards production? In this role, you’ll work at the practical heart of scale-up: designing, building and commissioning a catalyst production pilot line, then using it to run tests, develop process knowledge and deliver new capable products to our production plants. Your work will also support production teams with troubleshooting and help plant engineering make informed equipment decisions.

**Responsibilities

**Your primary objective will be to deliver capable new catalyst products, supported by well-established and understood process windows, to the industrialization step—the next stage in our new product development stage-gate model.

You will plan and carry out work safely, optimize equipment and processes, report your findings, and document relevant best practices. You will also work with production and engineering colleagues to address equipment and process needs.

**This Will Involve

**

• Designing, building and commissioning equipment for a catalyst production pilot line.

• Performing tests at the Manufacturing Development Centre, including completing safety assessments and reporting results.

• Troubleshooting production challenges and supporting problem-solving as a subject-matter expert in relevant unit operations and equipment.

• Assisting plant engineering and EPCM with equipment selection, testing (on site or at vendors) and reviews.

**What You Will Bring

**

• Equipment and/or unit operation subject matter expert in e.g. powder handling, milling, screening, continuous furnaces etc.

• Experience in Plant process engineering and commissioning experience

• Minimum 7 -10 years of relevant experience

• Experience troubleshooting and solving problems in industrial production processes.

• A practical, hands-on approach and confidence working directly with equipment.

• The ability to write clear, scientifically sound reports in English and communicate fluently in English, both spoken and written.

• Flexibility to manage changing priorities and work to tight timelines.

• Ability to work with several tasks and projects simultaneously, being robust/resilient when faced with challenges

**It Would Also Be An Advantage To Have

**

• Experience with production process scale-up or scale-down.

• Danish, both written and spoken or with a willingness to learn the language

• Project management experience.

• Knowledge of risk assessment, data handling or statistics

• Ability to think strategically and proactively seek information with respect to what is needed for future pilot development, Project manager experience, knowledge on risk assessment.

• Knowledge on data handling and statistics an advantage

**Why join us

**You’ll have the opportunity to be a part of accelerating new catalyst products to the market by building and operating a pilot facility, take part in practical testing, optimizing, and solve real equipment and production challenges. The role brings together design, hands-on problem-solving and technical reporting, with work that supports scale-up and manufacturing development.

**Your new Team

**You’ll join R&D’s Scale-up and Manufacturing Development team. You’ll work with colleagues involved in developing and industrializing new catalyst products, pilot testing, production troubleshooting and plant engineering support. The team’s work connects equipment and process development with the needs of industrial production.

**How You Can Apply

**If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.

**Application deadline: 23-11-2026.

**If you have questions regarding the role, feel free to reach out to Ninna Halberg Jokil, Director- Scale up and Manufacturing development, on NIH@topsoe.com.

You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.

To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.

To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.

**About Us

**Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.

Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.

We offer world-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.

We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more, visit www.topsoe.com.

At Topsoe we strive towards having a safe work environment. We are aware of the risks in our work and continuously optimize our safety procedures.

Activation at Sunrise TcTa is where business and brand strategy connect with content, creativity, media and tech. The team focuses on effectiveness — achieved through proven frameworks that align strategy and activation, driving measurable results for both Danish and international brands, mostly within the B2B sector.

We believe tactics without strategic understanding never lead to real impact… and the other way around.

Right now, we’re reshaping our setup to bring content, creative and media even closer to business and brand strategy.

About the position

We’re looking for a Paid Social Strategist to help set the direction for our paid media discipline within Activation together with the team and the management group.

You’ll bridge performance and media with strategy and creativity, ensuring that every campaign and initiatives delivers on marketing and sales KPIs as well as strategic objectives across brand, marketing and comms.

The role combines hands-on paid media management with strategic consultancy on LinkedIn and Meta.

It’s a plus if you also have experience with HubSpot and enjoy collaborating closely with our Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists.

Your tasks will include

• Plan, manage and optimise paid campaigns — primarily on LinkedIn and Meta.

• Translate business and brand strategies into actionable paid media plans that drive measurable results.

• Collaborate with Content, Tech and Brand Strategy specialists to ensure integrated execution.

• Advise clients on how paid, content and tech can strengthen marketing and sales effectiveness.

• Contribute to developing our paid frameworks and thought leadership within B2B activation.

• Work closely with the team on performance reporting and the use of HubSpot to connect paid activity to pipeline and revenue.

Your profile

• 3–5 years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, preferably within B2B marketing.

• Proven experience managing LinkedIn Campaign Manager and Meta Business Suite.

• A strategic mindset with strong analytical and creative understanding.

• Confidence in client dialogue — able to advise senior stakeholders.

• Interest in cross-disciplinary collaboration and working closely with other specialists.

• Experience with HubSpot is a plus.

About Sunrise TcTa

Sunrise TcTa isn’t a large conglomerate agency with standardised processes. We’re a privately-owned boutique agency based in Copenhagen. Independent and built to develop tailor-made strategic and creative solutions across industries, mostly B2B and often with an international footprint.

We’re a team of 30+ advisors, including brand and content strategists, creatives, designers, project managers and anthropologists.

Transitions are never easy.

But they’re often necessary.

Join us in working with the commercial ones.

Sunrise TcTa – Brand, Marketing & Commercial Strategy.

How to apply

If Sunrise sounds like the place for you, send your application and CV no later than 30 November 2026.

Please submit your application using the form below.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to reach out to Jonathan Riis Gilmartin, Partner, Activation at jrg@sunrise.dk or by phone at +45 51 93 21 32.

**Our Purpose

**Planday from Xero is a leading digital solution that uncomplicates everyday scheduling and workforce management by making it easier for businesses and shift workers around the world to communicate, collaborate, and get work done.

Powered by a community of local industry experts, Planday provides a best-in-class digital platform that is easy to use, accurate, secure, and compliant with local needs and standards. From payroll and accounting to POS and reporting, its open API and tech ecosystem is scalable to fit shifting business needs and to build an engaged, flexible workforce.

Founded in 2004, Planday is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark and supports over 400,000 users across Europe, Australia and the US. Planday was acquired by Xero in 2021.

**How You’ll Make An Impact

**As our Lead Engineer- Data, you will set the architectural direction of the data platform that enables both the decisions we make internally and the data-driven features our customers rely on. Working with the Data, ML, Platform, and Product Engineering teams, you will keep ingestion, modelling, and orchestration dependable, and define the modelling, testing, and documentation standards the data function depends on. You will innovate on how people work with data, building the agentic tooling and semantic modelling that let teams across Planday work from trusted data with confidence.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Set the architectural direction of our data platform so it serves analytics, product engineering, and AI/ML from one coherent design, collaborating with Platform and ML engineering on shared infrastructure.

• Design the dbt models, semantic layer, and quality standards the data function depends on, with the validation and lineage to make them trustworthy downstream.

• Own orchestration and observability in Dagster, and onboarding new sources in a way that scales.

• Innovate on self-serve and AI-enabled analytics, from semantic models and agentic workflows to our BI layer.

• Build the historical and low-latency foundations that make predictive and real-time use cases possible.

• Introduce better modelling standards, tooling, and development environments.

• Keep the platform reliable, performant, cost-effective, and compliant.

**Success looks like

**

• Architecture that holds up as we scale and as new use cases emerge, and that other engineers follow as a pattern.

• Analysts ship faster and more efficiently because your tooling & standards remove friction.

• A drop in repeat requests to the data team, as stakeholders answer their own questions through agentic workflows.

• ML and product teams have the historical and real-time data they need, without bespoke workarounds.

• Strong working relationships with the Data, ML, and Platform teams.

**What You’ll Bring With You

**

• Deep, hands-on Snowflake and dbt experience: modelling, semantic layers, agents & skills, testing, performance and cost tuning.

• Production experience with a pipeline orchestrator, ideally Dagster (or similar Airflow, Prefect), including dependent workloads, partial failures, and observability.

• Modern cloud infrastructure (Azure/AWS/GCP) and Kubernetes experience deploying and operating containerised workloads, plus infrastructure as code (Terraform).

• Strong SQL & Python for pipelines, services, and automation.

• Software engineering discipline across CI/CD, testing, and code review.

• The ability to turn technical trade-offs into clear narratives that help stakeholders decide and trust the work.

• Experience operating data systems, including incident response, cost, and data privacy practices.

**At Planday, we offer you

**

• Benefits like pension, health insurance, inclusive support for new parents and generous vacation

• On top of your annual base salary, you are offered to be part of an Employee Share Plan

• Growth and progression opportunities – we want you to grow with us

• Flexible remote work

• Strong social culture with lots of team and company activities

• Meaningful work – everyone at Planday contributes to improving the lives of shift workers around the globe

• Healthy work-life balance and autonomous approach to work. We trust in you and your abilities

Finally, our offices are not just workplaces (although they are pretty nice and well-located, we have to say!). Plandayers are open and welcoming and at Planday, everyone has the freedom and support to show their true self at work.

_At Planday, we firmly believe that diversity and inclusion are the cornerstones of innovation and a vibrant workplace culture. As an equal opportunity employer, we strive to create an equitable experience for all candidates throughout the process. Please let us know if you need any reasonable adjustments during the application or interview process.

jobs.description:
Take a leading role in delivering Maersk’s next generation of vessels!

You will combine naval architecture expertise with hands-on project management, steering complex newbuilding activities from early design and specification through construction and delivery.

Maersk is transforming its fleet through new technologies, new fuels and ambitious requirements for safety, efficiency and sustainability. You will join Fleet Technology in Copenhagen and work directly with shipyards, designers, classification societies, equipment makers, site teams and specialists across Maersk.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration and continuous learning, and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

About the role

This is a project delivery role with a strong naval architecture foundation. You will lead and coordinate engineering work across disciplines, turn technical findings into clear recommendations and help mature key matters towards timely project decisions. Your judgement will influence vessels from the drawing board until they enter service.

What you will do

• Lead naval architecture and newbuilding project activities from concept development and specification through detailed design, construction and delivery.

• Plan, coordinate and follow up engineering activities, interfaces, risks and decisions across project teams, shipyards and site offices.

• Drive design reviews, plan approval topics, technical evaluations and trade-off studies with internal and external partners.

• Continuously challenge how we can make our vessels safer, smarter, more efficient and more sustainable.

• Translate technical analyses into clear recommendations that enable well-informed decisions.

• Act as a naval architecture subject matter expert while building alignment across disciplines and organisations.

• Contribute to major conversions, fleet optimisation and strategic technology initiatives alongside our newbuilding portfolio.

• Support and share knowledge with colleagues in a collaborative environment with flat team structures and a strong sense of shared ownership.

What we are looking for

• A degree in Naval Architecture and 5+ years of relevant experience in ship design, newbuilding or maritime engineering.

• Proven project management experience from ship newbuilding or major conversion projects, gained with a shipowner, shipyard, designer, consultancy or classification society.

• Experience taking engineering work from concept and specification into detailed design and execution.

• A solid understanding of vessel design, ideally including areas such as stability, structural, statutory or classification requirements.

• Experience with technical specifications, design reviews and/or plan approval.

• The ability to coordinate multidisciplinary work, manage technical risks and keep complex activities moving forward.

• Sound engineering judgement, a collaborative working style and clear written and spoken English.

It is an advantage if you also have

• Direct experience working with shipyards during newbuilding design and construction.

• Experience with design optimisation and technical trade-off studies balancing performance, cost and project constraints.

• Knowledge of container vessel hull structure, lashing and cargo systems, outfitting or accommodation design.

• Experience coordinating, supporting or mentoring other engineers.

Why join us?

Few roles offer this combination of technical depth, project ownership and direct influence on large newbuilding programmes.

You will see projects develop from an initial idea into vessels operating in global service, working in an international engineering environment where technical discussion, collaboration and ownership are valued.

If you enjoy solving ship-design challenges and want to take an active role in delivering Maersk’s future fleet, we would like to hear from you.

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing  accommodationrequests@maersk.com.

Opportunity

Are you interested in turning complex business needs into data products that make a real difference?

As a Product Owner within our Commercial Data Products and Reporting team, you will own and develop data products that help our Commercial and Commercial Finance teams make better, faster and more consistent decisions.

You will manage a portfolio of data products, including datasets and data cubes used for commercial analysis and reporting. Sitting between business and technology, you will translate stakeholder needs into clear requirements, shape solutions with our technology teams, and ensure we focus our efforts on the work that creates the greatest value.

Our team brings together Product Owners based in Copenhagen and reporting colleagues in Pune, and you will collaborate with colleagues across business, data and technology.

Please note that this role is based in Copenhagen and requires onsite presence in the office five days per week.

What you’ll be doing

• 
Own the vision, roadmap and backlog for your assigned commercial data products.

• 
Work closely with Commercial, Commercial Finance and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into clear requirements and user stories.

• 
Act as a trusted sparring partner and bridge between business and technology, translating business needs into technically informed requirements while constructively challenging assumptions and proposed solutions.

• 
Prioritise the backlog based on business value, technical feasibility and delivery capacity.

• 
Partner with technology teams to shape scalable data solutions and support delivery through Agile ways of working.

• 
Apply your understanding of data models, data sourcing and transformation processes to ask the right questions and constructively challenge proposed solutions.

• 
Support the development and evolution of datasets, data cubes, KPIs and reporting foundations.

• 
Identify and shape opportunities to embed AI and automation into our data products, while also using AI to improve how we explore, design and deliver solutions.

• 
Collaborate closely with our reporting team and other Product Owners to ensure our data products work effectively across the wider organisation.

• 
Promote consistent KPI definitions, strong data quality and trusted reporting in line with our One Set of Numbers principle.

• 
Drive adoption, monitor product performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

What we’re looking for

You combine strong product thinking with enough technical understanding to work confidently across business, data and technology teams.

You do not need to be a hands-on data engineer, but you should understand how data is sourced, transformed, structured and delivered well enough to engage with and challenge technical colleagues when needed.

Your background could be in product ownership, data engineering, business intelligence, analytics, finance, commercial performance or another related field. We welcome different career paths and are interested in the capabilities and experience you bring.

We’re looking for someone with:

• 
Approximately 5+ years’ experience working with data products, BI, analytics, data engineering, reporting or product ownership.

• 
Experience translating business needs into user stories, requirements and prioritised backlogs.

• 
A good conceptual understanding of data models, datasets and data-transformation processes such as ETL.

• 
AI-enabled product development: Experience or a strong interest in delivering AI-enabled products and using AI tools throughout the product lifecycle, from exploring requirements and shaping solutions to improving delivery and ways of working. You bring curiosity about emerging AI capabilities and can identify where they can create meaningful business value.

• 
Experience working with technical teams using Agile principles and tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps or similar.

• 
Strong stakeholder skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts in a clear and accessible way.

• 
Good business acumen and curiosity about how data can improve commercial decisions.

• 
A proactive mindset and the confidence to ask questions, challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for improvement.

Experience within commercial, sales, finance, logistics or shipping would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Ready to make an impact?

If you enjoy bringing business and technology together and want to shape data products that support decision-making across a global organisation, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply to join the team and help us turn data into meaningful business value.

_As our new Test Manager, you will play a key role in delivering our SitaWare and Iris suites, an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset that helps Defence customers make critical decisions wherever they need it. You will apply your broad test and engineering skills in an agile environment with highly skilled colleagues, as part of our growing Defence Services team in Copenhagen.

**The job

**Our SitaWare and Iris suites give armed forces an integrated, ultra-modern command-and-control toolset spanning radio, mobile, vehicle, web and application-based solutions, with real-time reporting back to command HQ. As our new Test Manager, you will be involved in everything from the start of a feature, writing test cases and managing the process, through to verifying the final testing before we deliver the solution to our Defence customers.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning and conducting acceptance tests (FAT and SAT) with customers, both at our own facilities and at customer sites

• Conducting integration tests with third-party software and hardware

• Challenging solution design against risks, based on system context, customer requirements and security

• Taking part in military exercises to support the use of our solutions and find new ways of testing that reflect real-life use

• Establishing and maintaining test environments, and contributing to tender and proposal work on test and test management approach

You should expect travel within the Nordics, and potentially elsewhere in Europe, several times a year.

**Joining the team

**You will join a small but growing team in a brand-new office in the heart of Copenhagen, working closely with your Nordic colleagues while also collaborating with other teams across our global constellations. Testing is an integral part of our development process, and you will be part of a wider community of testers and test managers, with knowledge-network events to exchange ideas, hear lectures, share best practice and get to know your colleagues. It is an agile, fast-moving environment with flexible, trust-based working hours and plenty of room for personal responsibility.

**To succeed in this role, you bring:

• A technical degree, Bachelor's or Master's

• Solid experience as a Test Manager or in a similar role, with strong technical skills

• Experience with test management tools such as TestRail and Jira, including the Xray and R4J plugins

• Hands-on experience with test execution in close cooperation with stakeholders, and the ability to analyse and communicate technically complex solutions

• Solid knowledge of Windows and Linux environments, SQL/MS SQL Server, Active Directory, and networking fundamentals (IP, TCP, UDP, multicast, routing, firewalls), along with scripting skills in PowerShell or Bash

• Fluent Danish and English

• The ability to understand product requirements and translate these into effective tests

• Enjoys working in a changing environment, eager to step outside your comfort zone to make a difference

• Highly motivated to develop and apply your technical skills in a broad, technical role

• Enjoys customer-facing activities such as presentations, technical support, training and testing, building the trust that drives customer satisfaction

• Self-motivated and committed, with a hands-on approach

ISTQB or TMAP certification, automated testing experience, or experience with testing standards such as ISO/IEEE 29119, ISO 25010 or ISO 9001 are an advantage.

Experience with radio networking (e.g. VHF, HF) or tactical communications systems is a strong plus.

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

jobs.occupation: Data Center Facilities Technician II, Electrical
jobs.description:
**Minimum qualifications:

**

• Associate's degree, trade school certification, or other certified training in a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of electrical experience (e.g., electrical testing equipment or electrical distribution) in industrial or commercial environment.

• Ability to participate in material handling tasks such as lifting, carrying or moving up to 50 lbs (23 kg) of equipment, the required use of safety equipment such as limited weight bearing work platforms, ladders, step stools and personal protective equipment (PPE) like safety harnesses in accordance with safety and ergonomic guidelines and assessments.

• Ability to work non-standard hours and work rotations/shifts.

**Preferred qualifications:

**

• Experience in data centers, hospitals, or power plants.

• Experience in electrical maintenance in critical large scale facilities (Data Center, Pharma, Medical or Electrical) including UPS, generators, LV/MV switchgear Strong electrical safety awareness and ability to develop switching procedures and RAMS.

• Knowledge of electrical systems used in a data center environment (e.g., Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units).

• Knowledge of meters, devices, sensors, and troubleshooting utilizing standard hand tools, digital metering, or calibration/diagnostic equipment.

• Ability to communicate with contractors who perform maintenance or upgrade work on the data center systems.

**About The Job

**The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Denmark: kr.600000 - kr.615000 (DKK) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

**Responsibilities

**Learn more about benefits at Google .

• Inspect, maintain, and repair various data center systems.

• Provide daily assistance to technicians as you read blueprints/schematics/sequence of operations, conduct tours of systems, and assess their working order.

• Manage the uptime and maintenance of UPS, generators, electrical distribution, and control and monitoring systems.

• Operate, monitor, maintain, and respond to abnormal conditions in the data center facilities systems and equipment.

• Support startup, commissioning, and integration of new electrical equipment and systems into facilities infrastructure.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. **ARE YOU READY TO DRIVE GANNI’S WHOLESALE GROWTH ACROSS SCANDINAVIA WITH PURPOSE AND PASSION?

**GANNI is looking for a Wholesale Area Manager to join our global Wholesale team!

In this role, you will play a key part — together with your fellow Area Managers — in elevating GANNI’s brand presence across the Nordics market by nurturing strategic wholesale relationships and ensuring strong commercial performance.

The area manager will take over the whole Scandinavian market to contribute to regional growth and brand elevation in close collaboration with the broader EMEA Wholesale team.

This is a dynamic mid-level role that blends commercial execution, market insight, and operational excellence — and we’re looking for someone ready to contribute and grow within an ambitious team environment.

**Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Wholesale Area Manager, you will support and manage wholesale partnerships across the Nordics region, working closely with other Area Managers, the Head of WS EMEA and the Executive Wholesale & Franchises Director.

Your role will focus on driving sales performance, strengthening category growth, and ensuring seamless alignment between GANNI and our wholesale partners — all in line with our global wholesale strategy.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**

• Develop and execute a comprehensive business plan aligned with the brand strategy to drive growth and strengthen GANNI’s presence across the Nordics.

• Participate in prospecting and onboarding of new wholesale partners across the Nordics.

• Strategically collaborate with wholesale partners to meet weekly, monthly, and annual trade expectations.

• Monitor sell-in and sell-out performance, taking proactive measures to maximize sell-through, reorder rates, and profitability.

• Ensure all partners and activations are aligned with GANNI brand guidelines and deliver a consistent brand experience.

• Collaborate with marketing, VM, and merchandising teams to deliver local marketing initiatives, activations, and sales-driving campaigns.

• Provide exemplary day-to-day support to our wholesale partners as their main point of contact with GANNI HQ.

• Support showroom operations in Paris, including OTB discussions/negotiations and collection feedback.

• Stay up to date on the Nordics market trends, competitors, and opportunities and actively share insights internally.

• Coordinate with logistics and internal teams to ensure timely delivery and payment follow-up.

**Must Have Requirements

**We are looking for a commercially driven and collaborative professional who thrives in a fast-paced and international environment.

• 5-7 years of experience in international wholesale within fashion/apparel.

• Strong understanding of the Nordics market dynamics, consumer behavior, and wholesale operations.

• Solid understanding of retail math, including sell-through, mark-up, and OTB planning.

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear actions.

• Experience building and maintaining client relationships.

• Experience supporting seasonal sales campaigns and showroom environments.

• Proficiency in Excel; experience with wholesale systems such as JOOR is a plus.

• Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally.

• Comfortable working across different markets and cultures within the Nordics.

• Flexibility to travel within the region as required.

• Fluent in Danish and English; additional Scandinavian languages are an advantage.

**THE GANNI WAY

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism** (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing Wholesale team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**You will be based at our Copenhagen HQ, while maintaining close and continuous contact with the Paris office and ensuring strong collaboration and alignment with the Denmark team.

We welcome applications from all people regardless of gender identities, sexual orientations, ethnicities, racial identities, religious beliefs, disability statuses and personal expressions. We only want to know why you’re great for this role, so please avoid including your picture, age, and marital status in your CV.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**About Kanpla

**Kanpla helps contract caterers create better dining experiences while cutting food waste. What started as a school project now serves more than 800,000 users across 5,000+ locations in 14 countries.

We're a team of 70+ and are growing aggressively across both Europe, UK & the US.

Our revenue comes from three places: software subscriptions, card payments on our platform, and the hardware and services we sell alongside our software. All of that runs through three legal entities (Denmark, the UK and the US) and three accounting systems. That's a lot of moving parts. So far, our VP of Finance has built and run the accounting setup, with support from our external partner ScaleUp Finance. As we grow, we want a dedicated person to take full ownership of the accounting & monthly close. That's where you come in.

**About The Role

**This is an ownership role. You'll be responsible and accountable for Kanpla's accounting function: the close, the numbers and the processes behind them.

The setup is up and running today, so you won't be starting from scratch. Our VP of Finance will onboard you and hand over the accounting, so you can take full ownership as quickly as possible. From there, the function is yours to run. ScaleUp handles day-to-day bookkeeping, payroll and VAT for our Danish parent company, and Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, supports you on the daily tasks.

Your job is to make sure everything going into the books is complete and correct, and that everything coming out of them is accurate and on time. Over time, we want to bring more of the work in-house and use external partners where it actually makes sense. You'll drive that, together with our VP of Finance.

You'll own finance operations end to end: what we invoice, what we collect, what we pay, what we pay our people, how we close the books and what we owe in VAT. That covers Denmark (e-conomic), the UK (Xero) and the US (QuickBooks).

We're also tidying up our structure across countries and investing heavily in automation, AI and data across the company, including a move to a new group-wide accounting / ERP system down the line. So there's plenty to build, not just to maintain.

This is a hands-on role, not a pure reporting job. You'll be accountable for making sure our numbers can be trusted, and you'll keep improving the processes behind them.

What you'll do

• Run the group close (monthly, quarterly and year-end) and lock the numbers on time, reviewing ScaleUp Finance's work along the way.

• Own AR and AP end to end: invoicing, collections, bank reconciliation and supplier payments.

• Make sure revenue matches across CRM, billing and accounting.

• Own VAT reporting across our markets, working with our external advisers.

• Manage payroll in Denmark, the UK and the US, including Employer of Record setups.

• Keep hardware margins on budget and sales in line with Incoterms and VAT, together with our Head of Hardware.

• Prepare financial statements and support budgeting and variance analysis.

• Be the main point of contact for our auditors.

• Keep improving controls and processes, and cut manual work.

What you'll bring

There's more than one route into this role. Strong candidates will probably bring most of the following:

• 4+ years in accounting or finance operations, in a growing international company or an audit or accounting firm.

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, as our parent company operates under Danish law.

• Hands-on experience owning a month-end close, ideally with an external accounting partner.

• Solid AR, AP and European VAT experience.

• Experience with e-conomic, Xero or QuickBooks, and the confidence to learn the others fast.

• Precision with reconciliations, and the habit of finding the root cause.

• The judgement to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

• Clear written English.

**Nice to have

**

• Experience from an international scale-up.

• Payroll experience, ideally across countries.

• UK or US accounting (or you'll pick it up on the job).

• ERP implementation or migration experience.

• Experience with hardware or Incoterms.

• Danish language skills.

What we offer

• Real ownership, with a direct line to the VP of Finance.

• A broad role across three countries, software, hardware, payments and payroll.

• The chance to shape our finance function, and grow with it.

• A competitive salary and real support for your development.

• Remote-first working and two off-sites or workcations a year.

Practical details

This is a full-time, permanent role, ideally based in Copenhagen, where our VP of Finance and the rest of the finance team sit. It covers our entities in Denmark, the UK and the US.

You'll report to Felix, our VP of Finance, and be part of a small finance team that also includes Karl, our part-time Finance Associate, who helps with accounts receivable, accounts payable, VAT and billing. Day to day, you'll work with Customer Success, Sales and Operations on invoicing and collections, and with our Head of Hardware on hardware. Externally, you'll work with ScaleUp, our auditors, tax advisers, payroll and Employer of Record providers, and payment partners.

We review applications on a rolling basis and aim to fill the role as soon as possible.

Turn our existing client base into our biggest growth engine, and kick-start your career in account-based sales!

**As a fulltime Account Development Representative at Relesys, you will play a pivotal role in unlocking the growth potential within our existing client portfolio. Where the Business Development team focuses on opening new doors, you focus on going deeper - identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities across our already strong client relationships with brands like Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, Vestas, Specsavers, Joe & the Juice, and many more.

In this role, you will work closely alongside our Account Manager and Client Success Managers, reporting to the Director of Sales based in Copenhagen. Together you will map white space, spot expansion signals, and book qualified meetings for our Account Managers and CSMs to take forward. It is a unique position at the intersection of sales and client relationships - and a powerful stepping stone towards becoming an Account Manager, Account Executive, or Client Success Manager 🚀

This is an exciting and transformative time to join Relesys. In strategic partnership with Private Equity fund Copilot Capital, the coming years will bring extensive growth and opportunities along the way. You'll get a unique chance to make a tremendous impact - not just on new business, but on the clients who are already trusting us to power their frontline workforce every single day.

**What You'll Be Doing

**

• Account-Based Outreach Generate qualified upsell and cross-sell pipeline, and execute structured, targeted outreach to contacts within existing client accounts - across cold calling, email, and LinkedIn. Engage new stakeholders, reactivate dormant contacts, and expand your footprint within each account.

• Expansion Opportunity Identification Map organizational white space and work with internal data and client insights to spot signals of growth potential - new departments, new markets, leadership changes, or product gaps - and translate these into qualified conversations.

• Pipeline Qualification & Meeting Booking Understand the current state of each client relationship, map out decision-makers and influencers, qualify expansion opportunities, and book meetings directly with the relevant Account Manager or CSM - handing off with context and confidence.

• Sales & CS Collaboration Partner with Business Development Consultants, Account Managers, and Client Success Managers to align on account health, priorities, and timing. Share insights from outreach to sharpen targeting and messaging.

• Market & Product Knowledge Become an expert with the Relesys solutions, our value proposition, and how different modules and use cases apply across industries. Stay current on trends in retail & hospitality, and connect it to our product releases and roadmap to articulate ROI to existing clients.

• Sales Discipline Own your activity metrics, pipeline targets, and weekly sales rhythm. Continuously improve outreach quality, conversion rates, and stakeholder mapping.

We invest heavily in training, coaching, and structured development to help you grow.

**Who are you?

**

• 6+ months of experience in outbound sales development, account development, or a client-facing commercial role - B2B SaaS experience is a strong advantage

• Comfortable with proactive outreach including cold calling, and building relationships in an account-based context - you know how to add value from the first conversation

• Strong desire to understand clients deeply: their business, their challenges, and where Relesys can help them grow

• Outstanding communication skills across phone, email, and LinkedIn - you engage stakeholders at multiple levels with confidence and clarity

• Thrive in a fast-paced with a target-driven environment and manage multiple priorities

• Experience from or genuine interest in the retail, hospitality, or frontline workforce industries is a plus - especially if you've worked as a frontline employee yourself

• Experience with MEDDPICC or Command of the Message is an advantage

• Preferred qualifications include a bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written 🇬🇧 and one of the Scandinavian languages.

• Based in or near Copenhagen

**What do we offer?

**

• "Once in a lifetime" growth opportunity in an aspiring unicorn business that will 5x over the coming 4-5 years backed by the Private Equity fund, Copilot Capital

• Career path towards becoming specialist within your field, Account Executive, Account Manager or similar

• Occasional travels to Relesys global offices in line with onboarding, QBRs, Company events etc.

• A collaborative and thriving office-first culture where team spirit and fun are at the heart of everything we do

• Delicious lunch scheme with cake every Thursday

• Homemade buns every Wednesday made by our lovely Piccoline

• Free barista coffee, tea, and a fridge filled with soda

• Massage sessions every second Monday

• Our stylish Nordhavn office, just 100 meters from Orientkaj Metro, offers easy access to public transport and stunning ocean views

• Thriving Culture Club that plans Friday bars, running club, Tuesday fitness w. professional instructor, Wednesday bathing club, Summer parties, Christmas Parties and many other social events!

****Who are we?

**Relesys isn't just another SaaS company; we are a dynamic force revolutionizing communication and performance management platforms. Established in 2014, we set out on a mission to bridge the gap between HQ and non-desk workers, fostering a thriving workforce.

What value do we bring? People are the heartbeat of our client's business. When employees are thriving and successful, businesses flourish and retention rates increase. Relesys enables our clients to achieve this through an all-in-one app that streamlines communications, training, and daily operations into their own customized and ever-evolving app 📱

With clients such as Salling Group, COOP, Carlsberg, and Vestas - to name just a few - Relesys serves clients in 15 different countries, supporting them in 40 languages with +500,000 licenses across 20,000 stores and users in +100 countries. We have a strong presence in the Nordics and EMEA, and we continue to increasingly attract clients from across the globe, as we are breaking into new, dynamic markets.

At Relesys, we're shaping the future for frontline workers across various industries: Retail, Hospitality, Production/Manufacturing, and Transportation – while having FUN, as our rule number one! Join us on this thrilling journey as we grow and venture into new horizons.

We believe in the talent of our people and in long-term collaborations where we value an informal yet highly professional culture. We always go 'the extra mile' for our colleagues and clients, but rule number one - Have fun! This rule is always at the forefront of our minds when we come to work, creating an environment that is filled with passion, energy, and inspiration. **QA Manufacturing Support Technician

****Be close to production and make a difference in quality every day

**At AGC Biologics in Søborg, Quality and Manufacturing go hand in hand. As our new QA Manufacturing Support Technician, you will play an important role in supporting manufacturing activities during solution preparation and ensuring that production documentation meets GMP requirements.

This position offers an exciting combination of working close to the production line and handling batch record reviews and buffer and media documentation. You will be an important link between QA and Manufacturing, helping to connect the two functions and support a smooth and compliant manufacturing process.

**Where Quality meets Manufacturing

**In this role, you will support the Manufacturing Batch Release process by ensuring that solution (media and buffers) batch documentation are reviewed in accordance with established procedures and GMP requirements.

**Your Daily Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Performing QA Oversight in the Solution Preparation production suite in VAT83B.

• Supporting manufacturing during review of batch documentation, including questions related to Good Documentation Practice.

• Reviewing and approving Buffer and Media Batch Production Records.

• Printing Batch Process Records and managing manufacturing labels.

• Providing real-time review of manufacturing records and logbooks.

You may also support scanning, archiving and other related activities when needed.

What makes this position particularly interesting is the opportunity to combine documentation review with direct interaction with production. You will be close to daily manufacturing activities while contributing to the Quality processes that support batch release.

**A dynamic team with strong connections to production

**You will become part of a dynamic and proactive QA team consisting of 7 Scientists and 4 Student Assistants.

The team works closely with Manufacturing, and collaboration is an important part of everyday work. Together with your manager and colleagues, you will help build strong connections between QA and Manufacturing, acting as a bridge between the teams.

This is a role for someone who enjoys being involved in daily operations, working with different colleagues and combining structured documentation tasks with close collaboration on the production floor.

**Bring your attention to detail and collaborative mindset

**We imagine that you hold a Bachelor's degree (BSc) or a qualification as a Technician in production. Ideally, you have experience from a GMP or GLP production environment or a QA department within the biopharmaceutical industry.

You bring an interest in, or previous experience with, reviewing Batch Production Records and Solution Preparation Sheets.

Strong communication and collaboration skills are important, as you will work with colleagues and stakeholders across functions. You are fluent in written and spoken English and communicate clearly with both internal and external stakeholders.

As a person, you have a positive mindset, are flexible and enjoy taking on new tasks and responsibilities. You thrive in a dynamic environment and are comfortable navigating uncertainties.

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

PanTarg is a Danish biotechnology company developing novel anti-cancer therapies in the form of antibody-drug conjugates (ADCs) for the treatment of aggressive cancers with high unmet medical need.

Our work is based on more than 30 years of research conducted at Rigshospitalet and University of Copenhagen, and our vision is to enable novel treatment options for cancer patients via a novel first-in-class approach to targeted therapy.

We are currently incubated at the BioInnovation Institute (BII), a Copenhagen-based incubation hub for biotech startups in Europe. Here, we are currently progressing through preclinical development, aiming to reach a stage of clinical testing within a few years.

The position

We are looking for a Staff Scientist to join our team on site at BII. We are looking for a candidate with robust experimental experience with both in vivo xenograft studies as well as in vitro methods such as assay development, ELISA, flow cytometry and dose-response studies of drug candidates in cell culture. The selected candidate will generate data that supports our early translational activities, our non-clinical safety studies, and business decisions.

Qualifications

In vivo experience – Xenograft models

• Robust (5+ years) of hands-on experience with xenograft models of cancer, including CDX, PDX and orthotopic models.

• Strong practical experience with standard in vivo procedures, including I.V. injection via tail vein (must-have), blood collection, tissue collection, necropsy and general animal monitoring. Experience in preparing drug formulations and dosing solutions for administration, including appropriate handling and preparation of injectable drug candidates, is also required.

• Experience in the context of pharmacokinetic (PK) studies will be considered an advantage.

• Experience in planning, conducting and monitoring in vivo studies, as well as managing external CROs conducting such studies.

In vitro experience – Laboratory assays and protein characterization

• 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience, with a strong focus on assay development, optimization and protocol troubleshooting.

• Experience with relevant assays and techniques, including ELISA, flow cytometry (multicolor panels) and dose-response studies of drug candidates in standard cell culture models.

• Good understanding of antibody biology and properties, as well as protein characterization, antibody concentration determination and purity assessment using techniques such as UV-Vis spectrophotometry, SDS-PAGE and Western blotting.

• Experience with additional laboratory methods and assay platforms is also relevant.

Data analysis and reporting

• Experience in analyzing, interpreting and presenting experimental data from both in vivo and in vitro studies.

• Ability to perform relevant statistical analyses, generate graphs and visualize experimental results.

• Experience in preparing clear and structured experimental reports and presenting study results and conclusions.

Other qualifications

• The optimal candidate will have obtained a PhD degree and have at least 4-5 years of experience from either pharma or biotech, or as a post doc.

• Good scientific project management and communications skills, and the ability to clearly and precisely present data to a professional audience.

• Good interpersonal skills, and the ability to thrive in a startup environment where flexibility and a can-do attitude is part of everyday work life.

• Fluent in the English language, written as well as spoken.

• On-site presence at the BioInnovation Institute in Copenhagen will be required.
